messages:
Andrea (All-hands): Quick follow-up from today's reliability segment — I promised to surface the core artifacts and a short owner list so we can avoid scatter. Posting links + lightweight asks here. Please ack and update INC-1991.

incident-bot: Incident INC-1991 (2026-05-03) archived. Full timeline + raw traces: https://internal.redwood/incident/INC-1991/timeline.

Maria (SRE): Root cause summary: policy-router leak triggered under high-concurrency prefix patterns; GC lag + stalled evictions led to queue buildup and downstream 504s. Patch path: limit alloc window + add guardrail in cache admission. See RCA: https://docs.redwood.com/rca/inc-1991-2026-05-03.

Jamal (Eng Runtime): I submitted a minimal patch that adds bounds-checking and a defensive free path. Code PR: https://git.redwood/eng/runtime/pulls/421. Intend to canary tomorrow AM behind a 5% ramp for 2h. Owner: Jamal.

Leo (Eng Platform): I'll own a fast fallback automation prototype so on-call can flip routing without console ops. Spike planned this week; will post design doc to https://phabricator.redwood/PLAT-706. Owner: Leo + eng-platform.

Priya (Customer Success): I'll draft a customer-facing summary and a per-tenant impact table for the CSMs. Need a list of IPs/tenants affected and the window. Owner: Priya. ETA Mon noon.

Ryan (CTO): Guidance on comms: crisp, show what happened, what we fixed, and how we're preventing recurrence. Offer a follow-up Q&A for any affected customers. I'll review the draft.

Andrea (All-hands): Action list I'm adding to INC-1991 (please verify):
- Hotfix + staging canary (owner: Jamal) — target: tomorrow 08:00 UTC.
- Fallback automation spike (owner: Leo) — prototype + playbook due EOW.
- Add eviction/memory saturation alert (owner: Maria) — rule + runbook due Wed.
- Customer impact table + note (owner: Priya) — draft Mon 12:00 UTC.
- CI regression for allocation pattern (owner: Eng Runtime) — ticket created for next sprint.
- SLO/alert threshold review (owner: SRE + Eng Platform) — propose changes in 2 weeks.

Maria (SRE): Example alert I'll add to ops (first-pass):
```
alert: PolicyRouterMemoryHigh
expr: policy_router_heap_bytes > 0.8 * policy_router_heap_limit
for: 2m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  summary: "policy-router heap above 80%"
  runbook: "https://internal.redwood/runbooks/policy-router-memory"
```
I'll push the panel and alerts to the allhands dashboard.

Jamal (Eng Runtime): Canary config note: limiting per-request kv_cache and enforcing seq_len cap = 2048 for canary. If we see no leak signal after 4h, proceed to gradual ramp.

Leo (Eng Platform): For fallback automation I'll scope a simple feature flag + queued job that re-routes traffic when eviction metric > threshold for >3m. Will include playbook for on-call.

Priya (Customer Success): ":wave: acknowledged" — collecting tenant list now. If anyone has additional customer-facing phrasing they'd like included, paste here.

Andrea (All-hands): Scheduling a 30m sync Thu 09:30 UTC to check status. If you can't make it, drop a short note here with updates.

Jamal (Eng Runtime): ":white_check_mark:" Hotfix PR open, running unit + stress tests. Will post staging canary link after deploy.

Maria (SRE): ":white_check_mark:" Added initial alert + runbook. Will iterate with Jamal after canary.

Leo (Eng Platform): ":white_check_mark:" Created prototype ticket and draft design doc.

Priya (Customer Success): ":white_check_mark:" Draft in progress, will @Ryan when ready for review.

Ryan (CTO): Thanks all. Let's keep updates concise in INC-1991 and use this thread only for immediate all-hands follow-ups. I appreciate the quick action.

incident-bot: INC-1991 owners updated: Jamal, Maria, Leo, Priya.

Andrea (All-hands): Closing — appreciate quick responses. If you add anything to INC-1991, mention "post-allhands" tag so we can filter. Reconvene Thu 09:30 UTC.
